title: Scripting Language Interpreter
requirements: Lexer → Parser (Pratt parsing) → AST (`std::variant` or polymorphic nodes) → tree-walking interpreter
Values: numbers, strings, booleans, arrays, maps, closures (environment chains with `shared_ptr`)
Error messages with line/column; a REPL
Stretch: compile to bytecode + a stack VM; mark-and-sweep garbage collector; call C++ functions from scripts
